question:
If ‘÷' and ‘-’ are interchanged, what will be the value of the given expression?

18 - 6 + 14 × 10 ÷ 5
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c0356462107c0e820de0c60e94d371b842a073db0a10f638501944cb6158285.png] 

Decoding the information,

The sign "÷" and "-" are interchanged.

Given:

18 - 6 + 14 × 10 ÷ 5 

After replacing the signs and using the BODMAS rule,

18 ÷​​ 6 + 14 × 10- 5\ =3+14 × 10- 5\ =3+140-5\ =143-5\ =138

Hence, **the correct answer is '138'.**
